# 1 Enoch Chapter 47 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 47:2 — "that they may not have to suffer forever" vs. "that they may not have to endure forever"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "that-they-may-not-have-to-suffer-forever" | Literal; implies ongoing suffering |
| LOGOS | "that they may not have to endure forever" | "Endure" is slightly broader |
| PNEUMA | "that they not have to wait in suffering forever" | Adds "wait" for the waiting sense |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "That they may not have to endure forever" (LOGOS). Captures both the waiting and the suffering without importing "wait" explicitly. PNEUMA's addition is understandable but not warranted by the text.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 47:4 — "the number of the righteous had been offered" vs. "fulfilled" vs. "reached"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-number of-the-righteous had-been-offered" | Literal; Ge'ez ʾassemʿa = to complete/fulfill |
| LOGOS | "the number of the righteous had been fulfilled" | Formal; "fulfilled" captures completion |
| PNEUMA | "the full number of the righteous had been reached" | Natural English; "reached" is less precise |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "The number of the righteous had been fulfilled" (LOGOS). "Fulfilled" conveys both completeness and the sense of divine appointment being met. "Offered" (EMET) is misleading (sacrificial connotation); "reached" (PNEUMA) is too neutral.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 47:4 — "blood of the righteous been required" vs. "avenged their blood"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "blood of-the-righteous been-required by-the-Lord of-Spirits" | Literal; "required" = sought out/avenged |
| LOGOS | "blood of the righteous had been required by the Lord of Spirits" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the Lord of Spirits had avenged their blood" | Makes the vengeance sense explicit |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Blood of the righteous had been required by the Lord of Spirits" (LOGOS). "Required" is the standard English rendering of the Ge'ez idiom for blood-avenging (cf. Gen 9:5: "from every man's brother I will require the life of man"). "Avenged" (PNEUMA) is accurate but too narrow.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
